submitted_prompt:
Edit Image 1, the six-frame rear-view raider walk sheet. Repair ONLY the legs in frame 2 (top-right) and frame 3 (bottom-left). Both currently repeat the long screen-left trailing leg from frame 0, so the cycle lacks the opposite contact.

Frame 2: advance the LEFT leg forward toward upper-right while the RIGHT heel leaves the ground. The long foreground leg must come from the screen-right hip; move its boot to the lower-right side of the silhouette. The LEFT boot recedes higher and closer to the body center as it reaches forward.
Frame 3: complete that opposite contact. The LEFT foot now supports the body ahead; the RIGHT leg extends behind. Show the long screen-right leg continuing down into the low foreground boot on the screen-right side, while the screen-left leg is foreshortened and its forward boot is higher. Do not repeat frame 0's long screen-left leg. Keep both legs anatomically attached to their original hips.

Preserve frames 0,1,4,5, all upper bodies, the six cell placements, body scale, upper-right/back-facing camera, and the broad bronze axe held in the anatomical-right/screen-right hand. Image 2 is the original raider identity reference only, never its idle pose. Preserve dark blue-charcoal cloth, ochre sash, dark torn trousers, brown boots, hair and crisp pixel clusters. Return the same complete three-column by two-row sheet with real transparent alpha, no labels or background.

references.role: Edit target: repair legs of phases2/3 only; preserve the remaining poses and upper bodies.
Accepted NE raider identity, rear upper-right camera, anatomy, clothing and anatomical-right axe reference. Never copy its idle pose in the correction.

observations.v1_failure: Phases2/3 repeated the long screen-left trailing leg; rejected as a complete alternating cycle. Real alpha existed but included a faint partial-alpha halo.
observations.v2_result: Phases2/3 now give the opposite screen-right foreground leg and raised/receding opposite boot. The edit changed non-target cells and painted an opaque checker; only corrected phases2/3 are selected.
observations.selected_composition: V1 phases0,1,4,5 plus V2 phases2,3. No body repainting or mirrored pose substitution.
observations.identity: Rear upper-right view, tied dark hair, blue-charcoal clothing, ochre sash, brown boots/bracers; axe stays in anatomical-right/screen-right hand. Walk silhouette is narrower and its blade slimmer/near edge-on compared with idle.
observations.phase_limit: Six key poses with distinct opposite contacts and passing legs; phases5/0 remain close, and arms/torso have modest motion. This is a provisional gait, not a biomechanical or production-motion guarantee.

conversion.engine: Actual external Pixel Respecter workspace.reconstruct and shared palettes.reduce_colors via import_assets.py
conversion.scale_policy: One common scale and source origin pattern; no per-pose fitting or centering. Common baseline was lowered two pixels after idle-transition review; phase-specific lift was preserved.
conversion.alpha: V1 crisp reconstruction uses its actual alpha and alpha_floor128. V2 border-connected cleanup uses RGB160 and tolerance100. No local windows or selected chromatic pixels removed. See selected/alpha-audit.json.

acceptance: Root viewed native1x/3x and source alpha comparison; approved provisional production integration with smaller-axe/narrower-body caveats, pending actual game check. Selected source/manifest/PNG/report bytes are frozen.
